blocks.heading: What a Accountant interview looks like
blocks.body: Most Accountant interviews lean on behavioral questions — "Tell me about a time…" — because past behavior is the best signal of future performance. Each question is designed to draw out a full STAR arc: the Situation you were in, the Task you owned, the Action you personally took, and the measurable Result. The coach probes for the parts you skip, the same way a careful interviewer would ask a follow-up.

blocks.heading: How to prepare for a Accountant interview
blocks.body: Work backward from stories, not scripts. Pick four or five experiences that show range — a win, a conflict, a failure you learned from, a time you led without authority — and practice telling each as a tight STAR arc with a number at the end. Then run them here: answer cold, read the feedback, and re-run the ones that came out vague. Two or three passes is usually the difference between remembering a story and delivering it.
